description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 02.05.2016 to 08.05.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs valuations and payments should be calculated. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
